entry.title: Winick, Lütkenhaus & Coles (2018)
entry.subtitle: Adam Winick; Norbert Lütkenhaus; Patrick J. Coles · 2018-07-26 (Quantum 2, 77); arXiv v2 2018-07-19
entry.summary: Reliable (lower-bound) numerical QKD key rates via two-step SDP with dual certificate; openQKDsecurity implements protocol-generic numerical key rates and parameter optimisation (per repo/search).

fields.label: Authors
fields.text: Adam Winick; Norbert Lütkenhaus; Patrick J. Coles

fields.label: Precise theorem
fields.text: Reliable (lower-bound) numerical QKD key rates via two-step SDP with dual certificate; openQKDsecurity implements protocol-generic numerical key rates and parameter optimisation (per repo/search). NOT transcribed.

fields.label: Limitations
fields.text: QKD key rates, not token unforgeability; MATLAB.

fields.label: What QMint adds
fields.text: CLOSE PRIOR ART: certified numerical security bounds with dual certificates + parameter optimisation from device parameters. QMint's 'certified numeric' grade must cite this methodology.
